Landing.title: All your contacts, together and organized
Landing.subtitle: Quick search, no duplicate contacts, and secure two-factor sign-in.
Landing.captionDetail: Birthdays and a note for every contact
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Simple for every day, complete for when your contacts add up.

anywhere.title: Always with you
anywhere.text: Your contacts live in your account, so a lost or new phone loses nothing. Sign in from any phone, tablet or computer.

search.title: Fast search
search.text: Find anyone in seconds by part of a name or number. The list is always in alphabetical order.

duplicates.title: No duplicate contacts
duplicates.text: The same number in any format, like 0912 and +98912, and matching names are found so you can merge or ignore them.

birthday.title: Birthdays and notes
birthday.text: Keep a birthday and a short note for every contact so nothing slips your mind.

actions.title: One tap to reach them
actions.text: Call, text or share any contact straight from its row in the list.

preferences.title: Persian and English, light and dark
preferences.text: A right-to-left and left-to-right interface, with the light or dark theme you prefer.

Landing.securitySubtitle: Your contacts are personal, so they stay yours alone.

private.title: Only for you
private.text: Each account can reach only its own contacts; nobody else sees them.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.text: Turn it on with an authenticator app; from then on nobody can sign in without the six-digit code.

sessions.title: Sign out everywhere
sessions.text: Signed in somewhere and forgot to sign out? End every session from Settings with one button.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.text: Delete your account whenever you like; all your contacts and data are erased for good.

what.a: A personal online phonebook that keeps your contacts in your account, keeps them in order and finds duplicates for you.

devices.q: Does it work on my phone?
devices.a: Yes. There is nothing to install; it runs in the browser on phones, tablets and computers and is designed for every screen size.

newPhone.q: What happens to my contacts if I change phones?
newPhone.a: Your contacts are stored in your account, not on the phone. Just sign in on the new one.

duplicates.a: Contacts with the same number, even written differently like 0912, +98912 and 0098912, or with the same name are shown together. You can merge or ignore them.

twoFactor.a: No. You can skip it when you sign up and turn it on from Settings at any time. We recommend turning it on.

birthday.a: Birthdays use the Persian (Jalali) calendar in the Persian version and the Gregorian calendar in the English version.

deleteAccount.a: Yes, from Settings. After you confirm your password, plus your code if two-factor authentication is on, your account and all your contacts are erased for good.

Landing.aboutText1: Contacts was built for one simple job: keeping your contacts in one place, in order and within reach. No clutter, no duplicates and no worrying about losing your phone.
Landing.aboutText2: The interface was designed for Persian and right-to-left from the start, with the Jalali calendar and Iranian phone numbers, and it comes in English too.
